theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the dominant, broad, durable theme (rank 1, breadth 0.833, durability 0.75, hurst=trend). The only trend-eligible theme with scorable ETF and high cohesion — a follower's chief risk is being under-exposed to the one narrative, not the theme's internal decay. Crowding (z=1.82) cautions sizing DOWN but explicitly forbids fading.
theses.dissent: Crowding z=1.82 and one_narrative=true historically mark late-stage concentration; China A-shares are mean-reverting (gate_helps=false), and the trend may whipsaw. Past directional accuracy 0.373 says the read is unreliable.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO

theses.dissent: If the Banks narrative stalls, a crowded-but-eligible alternative could catch a rotation; and underweighting an eligible trend theme is still a directional bet against a confirmed trend state.
